current_D_profile_closed_forms.parameter: For a D-profile indexed by F subseteq {1,...,k-1}, let m=max(F), with m=0 for F=empty.
current_D_profile_closed_forms.R1: For every currently live dynamic vertex u and color c, R1(u,c)=1 iff c belongs to the exact palette A(u).
current_D_profile_closed_forms.R2: For every currently live nonedge uv and color c, R2(u,v,c)=1 iff c belongs to A(u) intersect A(v).
current_D_profile_closed_forms.proof_strategy: Explicit proper colorings exist for every palette-admissible query. Same-side queries use two uniform side colors. For a nonedge l_i-r_j with j>i, split live L at threshold j: vertices below j may share the forced query color with r_j while vertices at/above j use a third color; all other R use the remaining color.

D_profile_behavior_collapse.different_max: If m(F)<m(F'), choose j with m(F)<j<=m(F'). Then R1(r_j,1)=1 in F and 0 in F', so different thresholds are genuinely R1-distinguishable.
D_profile_behavior_collapse.same_max_common_domain: If m(F)=m(F'), every R1/R2 truth value on coordinates live in both states is the same; it is determined only by the exact palettes and nonedge relation.
D_profile_behavior_collapse.domain_difference: Different F with the same maximum may still have different live left-vertex query domains. This can preserve exponentially many domain-aware behavioral classes, but the live-domain bitvector has only O(k) bits.
D_profile_behavior_collapse.U1_interpretation: Even 2^(k-1) domain-aware exact classes do not imply exponential representation size; an explicit O(k)-bit carrier may encode them.

polynomial_behavioral_carrier.name: KK_CHAIN_PRECOLORING_CARRIER_V1
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.static_data: k and the fixed indexed chain graph K_k; static graph description is O(k) under the defining order, or O(k^2) if stored explicitly.
dynamic_data: for each vertex in L union R union {z}: ACTIVE/FIXED/DELETED status
independent reconstruction receipt pointer when DELETED
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.size: O(k) words / O(k log k) bits with indexed vertices and constant-size statuses/colors; polynomial even under explicit adjacency storage.
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.why_color4_disappears_from_chain_core: Every L/R vertex is adjacent to fixed s4=4, so no legal extension ever colors an L/R vertex with 4.
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.z_rule: If z is active and not fixed, assign z=4 without loss: every R vertex already cannot use 4 because it sees s4=4. If z is fixed to c in {1,2,3}, simply remove c from the lists of its active R neighbors; if z is fixed to 4, no additional restriction arises.
query_algorithm: Add the proposed R1 or R2 fixed assignment(s) to a copy of the carrier; reject immediate fixed-color conflicts or a same-color fixed edge.
For every active unfixed L/R vertex build a list contained in common palette {1,2,3} by deleting colors used by its fixed neighbors.
Discard any independently DELETED block from solving and retain its reconstruction receipt.
Run the sealed constructive polynomial P7-free List-3 backend on the induced active L/R graph, which is an induced subgraph of a chain graph and hence P7-free.
The query is true iff this List-3 instance is colorable and all stored independent receipts remain valid.
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.update_algorithm: After a successful force, record the new fixed assignment and, when source metadata is required, run the sealed B2B1 deterministic canonical-return procedure. This updates ACTIVE/FIXED/DELETED statuses and receipts in polynomial time; no enumeration of prior or future profiles is required.
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.reconstruction: Combine the fixed assignment vector, the constructive List-3 witness on active L/R, z=4 when z is not otherwise fixed, the original seed, and independent deleted-component receipts.
polynomial_behavioral_carrier.lifecycle: Polynomial in k for storage, R1/R2 query, canonical update and reconstruction.

why_generic_hardness_firewall_not_violat.reason: K_k has the extra family-specific invariant that fixed s4=4 is adjacent to every L/R vertex, reducing the entire live chain core to a common three-color palette. Only the already authorized P7-free List-3 backend is invoked.

verdict.Kk_behavioral_classes: may remain exponential under domain-aware equivalence

critical_firewalls: Exponential realizable profile count was real but does not imply exponential exact representation complexity.
Exponential behavioral-class count caused by independently addressable/live-domain bits is also insufficient when an O(k)-bit carrier supports polynomial queries and updates.
This result is scoped to K_k and does not prove a polynomial carrier for arbitrary connected Q_ALL cores.
No recursive R1/R2 algorithm for the general source-valid class is authorized.

next_frontier.name: R5_B1B1C5B2B2_E1_FOUR_COLOR_ACTIVE_CONNECTED_CORE_STRESS_V1
next_frontier.target: Search for or classify source-valid connected-QALL families with superpolynomial realizable profiles where no single color is globally absent from the live dynamic core after fixed effects, so the K_k common-palette List-3 carrier cannot apply. Any candidate must still survive A/B/C and must be tested for exact carrier reuse before strong-negative interpretation.
